title: SSDU scan code with frozen multi-coil MRI prior

prior_art.paper: Self-Supervised Learning of Physics-Guided Reconstruction Neural Networks without Fully-Sampled Reference Data
prior_art.delta: Fit only a compact per-scan functional coordinate using the SSDU train partition while keeping the reconstruction prior frozen; reserve acquired k-space samples for disjoint self-supervised validation. The held-out analytic image truth is scoring-only.

hypothesis: Across three synthetic target scans, a single two-angle scan-level Givens code optimized only on an SSDU train partition will improve held-out target image NMSE by at least 1% over frozen sharing, remain within 1% of same-update ordinary affine/FiLM and private full-prior tuning, preserve held-out k-space residual, and save at least 25% actual per-scan deployment bytes versus FiLM and 50% versus private models.
mirror_coordinate: two scan-specific Givens angles on the four-channel latent feature; prior parameters frozen
logical_multiplicity: one SSDU-adapted reconstruction view per scan
no_leakage: adaptation code sees only measured train partition; disjoint acquired holdout samples and fully sampled analytic truth are never used in loss or early stopping

data.type: analytic synthetic complex phantom scans; 2-coil SENSE
data.operator: known site-specific two-coil sensitivity map and 8/32 Cartesian phase lines; train and heldout acquired lines are disjoint

controls: two-parameter native output affine scale/bias code
private full-prior SSDU fine-tune upper control

training.adaptation: 48 updates per scan on all eight slices, using only each slice's train-mask k-space; prior is frozen for affine/FiLM/Mirror
training.private_control: 48 updates per scan on the same eight-slice train-mask batch
training.selection: fixed schedule; no ground truth or holdout samples used in adaptation; no fresh access

metrics: target image NMSE / PSNR / magnitude-SSIM proxy (truth scoring-only)
actual complete per-scan and three-scan serialized inference payload bytes

storage.common_schema: common outer keys, metadata, and tensor framing; inference payloads include shared prior plus codes or full private states
paid: all scan codes or full per-scan fine-tuned models

success_gate: Mirror improves NMSE at least 1% versus frozen; is no more than 1% worse than affine/FiLM/private controls; heldout k-space RMSE is <=1.1x FiLM; actual complete bytes save >=25% vs FiLM and >=50% vs private models.
failure_gate: FAIL if Mirror does not improve frozen quality, loses to a simple same-size native code, fails heldout measurement consistency, misses actual byte gates, or requires more updates.
boundaries: Synthetic mechanism only; no acquired MRI, fastMRI, clinical scan or trained VarNet claim.
Three analytic scans and one anatomy generator cannot establish generalization.
No capacity claim from fixed updates.
failure_gate_result: FAIL: Mirror fails to improve frozen image quality (NMSE .68403 vs .64553), loses to a same-size two-value native affine code (.60978 at identical 5,457 B), and saves 0 B versus that control. It saves 1.16% vs FiLM, below 25%; fresh scan seeds remain sealed.
